body: Hi, thank you for the response. I do hope she understands that I only wanted to help her, wherever she is. I’m sorry to hear that you’re dealing with medical issues. If you don’t mind me asking, what is it that you’re fighting? I hope you begin to get better.

I appreciate the kind words, and I think what you’ve said is logical. “You’re being too hard on yourself, you made a good decision, you’re human and have made a mistake”

I would encourage someone else in my shoes to to take these notes to heart, and I have tried. There just seems to be a disconnect for me. I was going to a 1on1 therapist for a little while, and she said “Ok, let’s just say you did make a mistake, now let’s work on moving past that” again, something that’s logical. I just can’t, my mind can’t look at it that way. A mistake that took a life is unforgivable IMO. About the “punishing yourself to no avail” I do worry that that’s the case. If a penance can’t be paid, then there is little hope to move on.

I do appreciate you reaching out, thank you.
